title: Roasted Broccoli Crunch Salad
description: A simple and flavorful salad with roasted broccoli and crunchy vegetables.

ingredients.name: vegetable
ingredients.notes: such as carrots or bell peppers

ingredients.name: crunch
ingredients.notes: such as chopped nuts or seeds

instructions: Toss broccoli with 2 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until tender.
In a large bowl, combine roasted broccoli, chopped vegetable, and crunchy topping.
Drizzle with your favorite dressing and serve.
